extraEnvVars.description:
Array with extra environment variables to add
Settings without a chart valueKISS supports a few environment variables that this chart doesn't expose as a value. If you need them, set them here. When both a client ID and secret and a token are set, KISS uses the client ID and secret.
  • `AFDELINGEN_CLIENT_ID`, `AFDELINGEN_CLIENT_SECRET`: client ID and secret for the Objects API for afdelingen. The chart requires `settings.afdelingen.token` to be filled in; when the client ID and secret are also set, KISS uses those.
  • `GROEPEN_CLIENT_ID`, `GROEPEN_CLIENT_SECRET`: client ID and secret for the Objects API for groepen. The chart requires `settings.groepen.token` to be filled in; when the client ID and secret are also set, KISS uses those.
  • `SDG_OBJECTEN_CLIENT_ID`, `SDG_OBJECTEN_CLIENT_SECRET`: client ID and secret for the Objects API for Kennisartikelen (used by the sync job), instead of `settings.syncJobs.kennisbank.token`.
  • `VAC_OBJECTEN_CLIENT_ID`, `VAC_OBJECTEN_CLIENT_SECRET`: client ID and secret for the Objects API for VACs (used by the sync job only), instead of `settings.syncJobs.vac.token`.
  • `REGISTERS____INTERNE_TAAK_TOKEN`: token for the Objects API for Interne Taken, instead of `interneTaak.clientId` and `interneTaak.clientSecret`. Leave those two empty when you use the token.

customHeaders.description:
Custom headers to send to the Haal Centraal API, for instance when using a proxy such as iConnect. A value can be a string (sent with every search) or an object with a value per search type: `RaadpleegMetBurgerservicenummer`, `ZoekMetGeslachtsnaamEnGeboortedatum` or `ZoekMetPostcodeEnHuisnummer`.
Env: `HAAL_CENTRAAL_CUSTOM_HEADERS__` and `HAAL_CENTRAAL_CUSTOM_HEADERS____`
Using KISS with a proxy for BRP / KvK (for example iConnect)Proxies for the BRP and KvK often require certain headers. To pass the identification of the logged in user in a header, use `userHeaderName` (here and in `settings.kvk`); the value sent is the claim configured in `settings.oidc.medewerkerIdentificatie.claim`. To pass static information, use `customHeaders` (here and in `settings.kvk`). For the BRP, a header can have a different value per search type. Example for iConnect: 
settings:
  haalCentraal:
    userHeaderName: x-gebruiker
    customHeaders:
      x-verwerking: Burgerzaken
      x-doelbinding:
        RaadpleegMetBurgerservicenummer: BRPACT-Totaal
        ZoekMetGeslachtsnaamEnGeboortedatum: BRPACT-ZoekenAlgemeen
        ZoekMetPostcodeEnHuisnummer: BRPACT-ZoekenAlgemeen
  kvk:
    customHeaders:
      x-origin-oin: "00000000000000000000"
The same example as environment variables: 
HAAL_CENTRAAL_USER_HEADER_NAME=x-gebruiker
HAAL_CENTRAAL_CUSTOM_HEADERS__x-verwerking=Burgerzaken
HAAL_CENTRAAL_CUSTOM_HEADERS__x-doelbinding__RaadpleegMetBurgerservicenummer=BRPACT-Totaal
HAAL_CENTRAAL_CUSTOM_HEADERS__x-doelbinding__ZoekMetGeslachtsnaamEnGeboortedatum=BRPACT-ZoekenAlgemeen
HAAL_CENTRAAL_CUSTOM_HEADERS__x-doelbinding__ZoekMetPostcodeEnHuisnummer=BRPACT-ZoekenAlgemeen
KVK_CUSTOM_HEADERS__x-origin-oin=00000000000000000000
Without helm, a header without search type (e.g. `HAAL_CENTRAAL_CUSTOM_HEADERS__x-doelbinding=BRPACT-ZoekenAlgemeen`) can be combined with a value for one specific search type; the specific value takes precedence for that search type.

About PABC (Platform Autorisatie Beheer Component)The integration with PABC is optional. When both `baseUrl` and `apiKey` are set, the integration is activated. The application name `kiss` is hardcoded in KISS.

KISS only accepts PABC application roles whose names match the role names in `settings.oidc` (`klantcontactmedewerkerRole`, `redacteurRole`, `beheerderRole`, `kennisbankRole`). Leave those settings empty (KISS then uses the default names `Klantcontactmedewerker`, `Redacteur`, `Beheerder` and `Kennisbank`), or make sure the application roles in PABC have exactly the configured names.

Set up PABC first, and only then deploy KISS with the PABC configuration. Otherwise no user gets a KISS application role. See the PABC documentation for setup instructions.

registers.description:
Sets of registers for klantcontacten and zaken. Each set consists of a klantregister, contactmomentregister, contactverzoekregister (interne taak) and a zaaksysteem that belong together. The file `values.schema.json` of this chart describes the possible configurations.
Env: `REGISTERS____…`, where the first item gets `__0__`, the second `__1__`, and so on.
How the sets of registers work
  • There must be exactly one set with `isDefault: true`. Klanten, contactmomenten and contactverzoeken are created in the default set, unless the context shows that the data belongs in a specific register. For example: if a contactmoment is about a zaak from a certain zaaksysteem, the contactmoment is stored in the contactmomentregister of the same set as that zaaksysteem.
  • A set uses either Open Klant 2 (`klantinteractie`) or the e-Suite / Open Klant 1 (`contactmomenten`, `klanten` and `interneTaak`). Use Open Klant 1 only to integrate with the e-Suite. The chart derives `REGISTERS____REGISTRY_VERSION` (`OpenKlant2` or `OpenKlant1`) from this. Without helm, set it yourself: when it is not set, KISS assumes `OpenKlant2`.
  • Secrets marked min. 32 characters below must be at least 32 characters long.
Fields of each set
  • `isDefault` (Env: `REGISTERS____IS_DEFAULT`): `true` for exactly one set.
  • `zaaksysteem.zakenBaseUrl` (Env: `REGISTERS____ZAAKSYSTEEM_ZAKEN_BASE_URL`): full base URL of the Zaken API, including the version. Example: `https://zaken.somezaaksysteem.nl/api/v1`
  • `zaaksysteem.catalogiBaseUrl` (Env: `REGISTERS____ZAAKSYSTEEM_CATALOGI_BASE_URL`): full base URL of the Catalogi API, including the version. Example: `https://catalogi.somezaaksysteem.nl/api/v1`
  • `zaaksysteem.documentenBaseUrl` (Env: `REGISTERS____ZAAKSYSTEEM_DOCUMENTEN_BASE_URL`): full base URL of the Documenten API, including the version. Example: `https://documenten.somezaaksysteem.nl/api/v1`
  • `zaaksysteem.clientId` (Env: `REGISTERS____ZAAKSYSTEEM_API_CLIENT_ID`): client ID for the ZGW APIs.
  • `zaaksysteem.clientSecret` (Env: `REGISTERS____ZAAKSYSTEEM_API_KEY`): secret for the ZGW APIs (min. 32 characters).
  • `zaaksysteem.deeplink.url` (Env: `REGISTERS____ZAAKSYSTEEM_DEEPLINK_URL`): optional. Base URL to deeplink to a zaak in the zaaksysteem, for example `https://zaaksysteem.mijngemeente.nl/mp/zaak/`. Always use this in combination with `deeplink.property`. When both are set, the zaak details screen in KISS shows a link that opens the zaak in the zaaksysteem. This only works for zaaksystemen with a fixed URL for zaak details, where only one property of the zaak (e.g. the zaaknummer) has to be appended to that URL.
  • `zaaksysteem.deeplink.property` (Env: `REGISTERS____ZAAKSYSTEEM_DEEPLINK_PROPERTY`): optional. The property of the zaak whose value is appended to `deeplink.url`, for example `identificatie`. Always use this in combination with `deeplink.url`.
  • `zaaksysteem.useExperimentalQueries` (Env: `REGISTERS____ZAAKSYSTEEM_USE_EXPERIMENTAL_QUERIES`): optional, `true` or `false`. Feature switch for the experimental features introduced in Open Zaak 1.20.0.
  • `zaaksysteem.usePabc` (Env: `REGISTERS____ZAAKSYSTEEM_USE_PABC`): optional, default `true`. Whether PABC zaaktype filtering (see `settings.pabc`) is applied to this zaaksysteem. Set to `false` for zaaksystemen with their own authorization (e.g. the e-Suite).
  • Open Klant 2:
  • `klantinteractie.baseUrl` (Env: `REGISTERS____KLANTINTERACTIE_BASE_URL`): URL of the Klantinteracties API of the Open Klant 2 register, without `/api/v1` (KISS adds that itself). Example: `https://klantinteractieregister.mijngemeente.nl/klantinteracties`
  • `klantinteractie.token` (Env: `REGISTERS____KLANTINTERACTIE_TOKEN`): token for the Klantinteracties API.
  • e-Suite / Open Klant 1:
  • `contactmomenten.baseUrl` (Env: `REGISTERS____CONTACTMOMENTEN_BASE_URL`): URL of the Contactmomenten API. Example: `https://contactmomentenregister.mijngemeente.nl`
  • `contactmomenten.clientId` (Env: `REGISTERS____CONTACTMOMENTEN_API_CLIENT_ID`): client ID for the Contactmomenten API.
  • `contactmomenten.clientSecret` (Env: `REGISTERS____CONTACTMOMENTEN_API_KEY`): key for the Contactmomenten API (min. 32 characters).
  • `klanten.baseUrl` (Env: `REGISTERS____KLANTEN_BASE_URL`): URL of the Klanten API. Example: `https://klantenregister.mijngemeente.nl/klanten`
  • `klanten.clientId` (Env: `REGISTERS____KLANTEN_CLIENT_ID`): client ID for the Klanten API.
  • `klanten.clientSecret` (Env: `REGISTERS____KLANTEN_CLIENT_SECRET`): secret for the Klanten API (min. 32 characters).
  • `interneTaak.baseUrl` (Env: `REGISTERS____INTERNE_TAAK_BASE_URL`): URL of the Objects API for Interne Taken. Example: `https://objectenregister.mijngemeente.nl`
  • `interneTaak.clientId` (Env: `REGISTERS____INTERNE_TAAK_CLIENT_ID`): client ID for the Objects API for Interne Taken. Usually a token is used; a client ID and secret are needed for example with the e-Suite (podiumd-adapter). Use either a client ID and secret, or a token (`REGISTERS____INTERNE_TAAK_TOKEN`, see `extraEnvVars`), not both. If both are set, KISS uses the client ID and secret.
  • `interneTaak.clientSecret` (Env: `REGISTERS____INTERNE_TAAK_CLIENT_SECRET`): client secret for the Objects API for Interne Taken.
  • `interneTaak.objectTypeUrl` (Env: `REGISTERS____INTERNE_TAAK_OBJECT_TYPE_URL`): URL of the Interne Taak Object Type. Example: `https://objecttypenregister.mijngemeente.nl/api/v2/objecttypes/f83fdc48-5ddb-4b1a-a347-e20092031399`
  • `interneTaak.objectTypeVersion` (Env: `REGISTERS____INTERNE_TAAK_TYPE_VERSION`): version number of the Interne Taak Object Type, for example `2`. KISS writes Interne Taken to the Objects API and must send the version of the object type. Which version is the most recent can differ per municipality.
Example (Open Klant 2 and Open Zaak)
settings:
  registers:
    - isDefault: true
      klantinteractie:
        baseUrl: "https://klantinteractieregister.mijngemeente.nl/klantinteracties"
        token: "..."
      zaaksysteem:
        zakenBaseUrl: "https://openzaak.mijngemeente.nl/zaken/api/v1"
        catalogiBaseUrl: "https://openzaak.mijngemeente.nl/catalogi/api/v1"
        documentenBaseUrl: "https://openzaak.mijngemeente.nl/documenten/api/v1"
        clientId: "..."
        clientSecret: "..."
Migrating from the deprecated ZAAKSYSTEEM_BASE_URLOlder versions of KISS used one variable, `REGISTERS____ZAAKSYSTEEM_BASE_URL`, for all ZGW APIs. This chart only supports the three separate URLs. KISS itself still accepts the old variable, but don't use the old and new format together. To migrate, replace the single URL by the three base URLs, including the version number. If every API runs on its own subdomain, use for example `https://zaken.mijnzaaksysteem.nl/api/v1`, `https://catalogi.mijnzaaksysteem.nl/api/v1` and `https://documenten.mijnzaaksysteem.nl/api/v1`. If all APIs run on the same URL, use for example `https://openzaak.mijngemeente.nl/zaken/api/v1`, `https://openzaak.mijngemeente.nl/catalogi/api/v1` and `https://openzaak.mijngemeente.nl/documenten/api/v1`.

sharepoint.description:
SharePoint sync jobs configuration. One sync job is created per item.
Fields of each item
  • `sourceName` (Env: `SHAREPOINT_SOURCE_NAME`): required. A human friendly name for the source, as shown in the search bar in KISS. Example: ICATT SharePoint Test Site.
  • `siteUrl` (Env: `SHAREPOINT_SITE_URL`): required. Full URL of the SharePoint site to crawl, for example `https://my-tenant.sharepoint.com/sites/my-site`. If this is a hub site, or the site has subsites, all underlying / related sites are indexed as well. Both 'modern' site pages and traditional wiki pages are supported.
  • `clientId` (Env: `SHAREPOINT_CLIENT_ID`): required. Client ID (application ID) of the SharePoint app registration. The app registration needs the API permission `Sites.Read.All`. Example: `0166786a-df05-4e1c-a75c-7c3317002ad8`
  • `clientSecret` (Env: `SHAREPOINT_CLIENT_SECRET`): required. Client secret of the SharePoint app registration.
  • `tenantId` (Env: `SHAREPOINT_TENANT_ID`): required. Azure AD tenant ID (GUID) of the SharePoint app registration. Example: `bd7f67dd-fc8c-4a9d-a1aa-c2e4d687b18f`
  • `schedule`: cron schedule of the sync job. Default `*/59 * * * *`
  • `historyLimit`: number of finished jobs to keep. Default `1`
  • `resources`: resources of the sync job container.
Reserved source names: don't use `Smoelenboek`, `VAC` or `Kennisbank` as `sourceName`, unless you don't use the corresponding source (a source is not used when it has no configuration). `Smoelenboek` belongs to `settings.syncJobs.medewerkers`, `VAC` to `settings.syncJobs.vac` and `Kennisbank` to `settings.syncJobs.kennisbank`.

website.description:
Website crawler jobs configuration. Websites are crawled by the [Elastic Open Crawler](https://www.elastic.co/guide/en/elasticsearch/reference/current/es-connectors-crawler.html); one crawler job is created per item. These settings are written to the crawler configuration, there are no KISS environment variables for them.
Fields of each item
  • `domain`: required. Full URL of the website to crawl.
  • `sourceName`: required. A human friendly name for the source, as shown in the search bar in KISS. Example: ICATT Test Site.
  • `outputIndex`: Elasticsearch index to write to. Default: `search-` followed by the `sourceName` in lower case, with spaces replaced by `-`.
  • `excludeTags`: HTML tags whose content is not indexed. Default `["header", "footer", "nav"]`
  • `crawlRules`: crawl rules of the Open Crawler, to include or exclude parts of the website.
  • `maxCrawlDepth`: maximum crawl depth.
  • `maxExtractedLinksCount`: maximum number of links extracted per page.
  • `maxUniqueUrlCount`: maximum number of unique URLs crawled.
  • `purgeCrawlEnabled`: remove pages from the index that were not found in the last crawl.
  • `fullHtmlExtractionEnabled`: store the full HTML of each page.
  • `binaryContentExtractionEnabled`: extract and index the content of PDF and Word documents.
  • `userAgent`: user agent of the crawler. Default `Kiss-Elastic-Crawler`
  • `threadsPerCrawl`: number of threads per crawl. Default `1`
  • `schedule`: cron schedule of the crawler job. Default `*/59 * * * *`
  • `historyLimit`: number of finished jobs to keep. Default `1`
  • `resources`: resources of the crawler container.
Reserved source names: don't use `Smoelenboek`, `VAC` or `Kennisbank` as `sourceName`, unless you don't use the corresponding source (a source is not used when it has no configuration). `Smoelenboek` belongs to `settings.syncJobs.medewerkers`, `VAC` to `settings.syncJobs.vac` and `Kennisbank` to `settings.syncJobs.kennisbank`.

It is advisable to consult your website administrator about fine-tuning the crawler, for example about the robots.txt, a KISS specific sitemap.xml or additional filters.
website.title: website
